title: Door with blood on lintel and doorposts, and the word hyssop
summary: A drawing of a wooden door frame with an open door, with red blood smears on the lintel above and both doorposts and on the ground at the threshold, with the word 'hyssop' written at an angle beside it. It illustrates the Passover blood on the doorposts from Exodus 12:22.

pictures.description: Simple flat drawing of a golden-brown wooden door frame (two doorposts and a lintel) with a darker brown door swung open, an orange doorknob, and scribbled red blood smears on the lintel, on each doorpost, and on the ground at the threshold. The word 'hyssop' is written diagonally in green (first letter dark red) to the right of the doorway.

uncertain: The first letter 'h' of 'hyssop' is dark red while the rest of the word is green; the meaning of this colouring is not stated.
